description: This file defines the virtual class CKEDITOR.eventInfo, which models the event object passed to event listeners in the CKEditor framework. It contains documentation and property/method descriptions for event handling.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.eventInfo
classes.description: A virtual class illustrating the features of the event object passed to event listeners in CKEditor.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Method to prevent further event listeners from being called.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Method to cancel the event if it is cancelable.
